newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Cement to increase cement capacity.
newsitem.headline: Siam Cement to increase cement capacity.

text.p: Siam Cement Plc said on Wednesday it would invest 8.7 billion baht ($334.5 million) to double cement production capacity at its Khao Wong plant in Saraburi.
Siam Cement, Thailand's largest conglomerate, said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the increase in production would bring total capacity at the plant to 6.4 million tonnes per year.
Construction on the plant should be completed by the fourth quarter of 2000.

The increased capacity, plus the capacity of the Tung Song plant, which is currently under construction, will bring Siam Cement's total cement production capacity to about 26.2 million tonnes per year, the company said.
